card.name: Inside foreign medical names and titles
card.fires_on: Partway through transliterated or foreign-language medical terms, book titles and institution names, and just before a doctor title or abbreviation. The marked piece is often a short fragment that begins a word such as 'Sykehus', 'médica' or 'clinical'.

modes.label: Foreign medical titles
modes.description: Fragments inside non-English journal, book or hospital names, often hyphenated.
modes.example: Lier Psychiatric Hospital (Lier Psykiatriske<< Sy>>kehus or Lier Asyl in

modes.label: Before a credential or acronym
modes.description: A comma or letter just before M.D. or inside an organization acronym.
modes.example: Back to top Robert H. Shmerling<<,>> M.D. is associate physician at Beth

modes.label: Start of 'medical/clinical' words
modes.description: A short piece starting a word meaning medical or clinical, in Spanish or capitalized text.
modes.example: Aplique directamente bajo la lengua segun indicacion<< med>>ica.

card.writes: It promotes odd word-piece continuations and suppresses 'Dr' and 'doc' forms, so it steers away from writing doctor titles next.
card.plain: It fires inside foreign-language medical names and just before a doctor's credentials, where the next piece is not the word 'Doctor'.
